label: c/t/j/z input early in the original phase, gated by first-token context
explanation: Original-phase unit (99% of mass), never fires at t=0, peaks at t=2-4 and fades by t>=6. Input-token selective: c (33% of mass, top activations), t, j, z, and weakly k; almost silent on other tokens, the delimiter and the copy phase. Fires mostly on first occurrences. Within those tokens, firing depends on preceding context: much more likely when the first original token is 1/u/h/x (then p/q/n/s/f) and when prev2 is u/p/q, i.e. a graded hidden-state context not cleanly captured. Token-only predicate (c/t/j/z, t=1..5) has mass recall 0.88 but precision 0.18; adding the first-token context raises F1 to ~0.45 (dev) at mass recall ~0.71. Largest activations: c at t=3-5 after contexts like u p k / 1 u u m.
